snippet.title: Mandragora: Whispers of the Witch Tree | Patch 1.6 Full
snippet.description:
Mandragora Patch 1.6 is here — New Game Plus has arrived. 

Dive back into the fray with all your hard-earned gear, skills, and knowledge, but prepare for an even rougher challenge.

Patch 1.6 also brings a host of quality-of-life improvements and balance adjustments. Download now and begin your next perilous journey!


Mandragora: Whispers of the Witch Tree is out now on PlayStation 5, Xbox Series X|S, and PC through Steam, Epic Games Store, and GOG:

🎮 Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/1721060/Mandragora_Whispers_of_the_Witch_Tree/ 
🎮GoG: https://www.gog.com/en/game/mandragora_whispers_of_the_witch_tree 
🎮 EGS: https://store.epicgames.com/en-US/p/mandragora-36280a 
🎮 PlayStation 5: https://store.playstation.com/concept/10004736 
🎮 Xbox Series X|S: https://www.xbox.com/games/store/mandragora/9pdk46p3ptqm
